item.title: From a day to an hour: fanning out invoice work over SQS
item.description: Every billing cycle we have to process invoices for all of our customers: pull them from the ERP, store them, make them visible in the customer area, and keep the related contracts in sync. For a long time this was one big job that went through the invoices one by one. It took about a day. The worst part was not the duration, it was what happened when it failed at 70%: figure out where it stopped, fix the data, start again, hope.
